controls.rationale: DCO-style web signoff is not cryptographic signed-commit enforcement and is not required by this hardening policy.
The authoritative merge process is the exact-final-HEAD strict gate. Mandatory human approval is a separate governance decision.
With required_approving_review_count=0 this setting is not counted as an effective hardening control.

Confirmed 2026-09-03 via `gh api repos/.../actions/permissions/workflow` (admin-scoped credential): default_workflow_permissions=read, can_approve_pull_request_reviews=false. This endpoint requires repository administration access, which a scheduled #38 workflow's low-privilege GITHUB_TOKEN does not have by default, so the readback mode stays manual-readback.

controls.expected: untrusted fork pull requests cannot receive write-capable tokens or repository secrets
controls.rationale: Confirmed 2026-09-03: `actions/permissions/fork-pr-contributor-approval` returns approval_policy=first_time_contributors, so first-time contributor fork PR runs require explicit maintainer approval. Independently of that setting, GitHub's default pull_request (non-target) trigger already gives fork PR runs a read-only, repo-scoped GITHUB_TOKEN with no repository secrets; this repository's one pull_request_target consumer (label-automation.yml) never checks out PR-head code, always checking out the trusted default branch, so it does not create a privileged-token/untrusted-code exposure.

Confirmed 2026-09-03 via `gh api repos/.../actions/permissions`: enabled=true, allowed_actions=all, sha_pinning_required=false. Left unrestricted rather than narrowed to selected-actions: CI depends on multiple third-party actions and an allowlist migration was not validated against them during #37. Effective fork-PR risk is bounded by token/secret isolation and the pull_request_target audit above, not by this allowlist, so it is hygiene rather than the binding security control.

Confirmed 2026-09-03: `gh api repos/.../code-scanning/default-setup` returned state=configured, languages=[actions,python], query_suite=default, threat_model=remote, schedule=weekly, matching PR #56's dynamic github-code-scanning/codeql runs. No checked-in CodeQL workflow is added; the admin default-setup endpoint requires repository administration access, so readback stays manual-readback for #38.
Do not require signed commits until Dependabot/bot/automation compatibility is proven. No required-signatures ruleset rule is expected today.
